_why: State that SHOULD reset when App re-keys a tab. Anything not listed here must live in that component's view-state interface, or test:viewstate fails. Adding a useState forces the choice; it can no longer be made by accident.

Dashboard.tsx.chartWidth: measured from the DOM on mount; the last width is kept in a module-level cache, so a remount starts from it and re-measures
Dashboard.tsx.isPeriodPickerOpen: a sheet is never mid-open across a remount; the period it picks is what persists
Dashboard.tsx.isTrendCategoryModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Dashboard.tsx.isTrendSubcategoryModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Dashboard.tsx.tooltipData: a chart tooltip belongs to a touch that has ended
Dashboard.tsx.showGreeting: governed by a module-level once-per-launch flag, not by the tab
Dashboard.tsx.reviewPointerGone: waving away the pointer to last month's review loses nothing - the review lives on that month permanently, so it need not survive a remount, and the first days of a month may reasonably offer it again

Activity.tsx.isCategoryModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Activity.tsx.isSubcategoryModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Activity.tsx.isSourceModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Activity.tsx.isSearchModalOpen: a modal is never mid-open across a remount
Activity.tsx.exportScopeOpen: a sheet is never mid-open across a remount; it asks again next time
